registrationRule: First commit adding exact plan and runner precedes historical replay; one fixed comparison only, no overrides or selected rows.
developmentActivationReason: User explicitly authorizes the already-fixed 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-11 development window. Override only activeFromTimestamp to its 2026-01-01 13:30+08 boundary for both arms; preserve v2 forward freeze/protocol and every other parameter/cost/risk. Old rows never become new forward.
benchmark: 3 units from first eligible evaluation quote, full next-event execution. Same initial100k, risk, public commission minimum, instrument tax and 100bps slippage; do not force close at cutoff. Separate terminal-liquidation estimate.

derivations.winDenominator: All completed trades including breakevens; open trades excluded and retained separately
derivations.exposure: Position mark / fixed initial capital, with event-weighted and calendar-time-weighted measures
derivations.holding: Actual first entry fill to final exit fill, both trading intervals and calendar days; open positions are right-censored at the fixed cutoff
derivations.aggregate: Four independent TWD100000 capital runs, summed TWD400000 equity. Calendar union carries last marks only for aggregate accounting. Never average symbol drawdowns or imply shared portfolio risk.
derivations.mechanism: Pair only identical filled entry time, entered quantity and actual entry cost. Retain all unmatched and open trades in whole-window economics. Identify cost-gate blocks followed by forced net losses, and worse PnL with longer holding.

interpretationBeforeResults: Preserve all completed wins/losses/breakevens and open positions; zero completions have null win rate.
Report net return vs baseline and benchmark, actual holding, capital-time exposure, drawdown, unknown-cost/no-exit and blocked-then-forced-loss risk.
Pair only identical actual filled entry timestamp/quantity/entry cost. List every unmatched/open entry and observed reason; do not rank-pair or cherry-pick winners.
If the economics and holding/downside do not support improvement, retain negative evidence and stop adding variants. No parameter tuning/promotion or efficacy claim from this inspected window.
attemptAccounting: Append-only exclusive attempt.json and immutable new v2 outputs. Saved final result is read-only on repeat; incomplete attempt is not automatically rerun. Do not inspect/create/remove any original .run.lock or durable journal.
limitations: All evaluation prices predate both candidate freezes and are already inspected development data.
Public fee scenario is not verified actual user broker terms; exact-cent notional and whole-TWD ceiling are declared conservative assumptions.
Company actions are incomplete for0056/2317 and fullsplit ledger; no dividends credited, so report price-plus-cost return rather than total return.
Official exchange-calendar completeness, per-row publication-time archive and realistic odd-lot next-event fills unverified.
Benchmark open positions are marked unrealized; hypothetical liquidation shown separately, no completed win rate.
Single historical window and dependent small trade samples cannot establish efficacy; descriptive Wilson intervals only.
